scripts.build: npm run web:build && npm run admin:build
scripts.setup:local: npm run db:migrate:local && npm run media:seed:local
scripts.dev: npm run setup:local && npm run build && wrangler pages dev public
scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy public
scripts.web:build: npm run web:install && npm --prefix web run build
scripts.admin:build: npm run admin:install && npm --prefix admin run build
